label: Nested-goal binding is a convention, not a gate - honored only when a template-shaped parent goal.md exists
claim: Phase parents bind children via ANCHOR:binding (each phase goal.md binds as if written here); playbook set-string instructs reading each phase's goal.md
groundTruth: Binding reality: 15 of 75 goal.md files carry ANCHOR:binding; 019 parent honors end-to-end; 033 parent (which BUILT the goal system) has NO parent goal.md; 018/013 goals are freeform without anchors; presence is optional (lazyAddonDocs) so a parent without one is unconstrained; a PRESENT goal.md gets anchor-checked via the validator presentAddons scan (orchestrator.ts:507-510); the operator objective string is explicitly unchecked (playbook:20)
recommendation: document (binding binds only when a template-shaped parent goal.md exists; legacy freeform goals sit outside the anchor system) or fix with an advisory rule

label: Two artifacts share the name goal: the plugin-persisted session objective and the goal.md packet document; no code connects them
claim: The live goal machinery persists session goals and injects passive steering; 8 speckit YAMLs offer it (goal_prompt_choice default-offer)
groundTruth: opencode_goal({action:set,objective}) stores an objective string under skills/.state/goal/; goal.md (manifest addon, durable directive/binding/criteria) is a DIFFERENT artifact the plugin never reads or writes (0 refs); the playbook set-string shape is the manual bridge (operator pastes goal.md text into the objective); the README/EXTENSION-GUIDE never disambiguate - root cause behind f-iter006-001 and f-iter002-001
recommendation: document (one paragraph: goal = session objective via opencode_goal; goal.md = packet document via manual render; former hand-derived from latter)
